subject: The trade you almost took
preview_text: A new feature that catches your near-misses. See what the AI would have said.
body_paragraphs: Remember that trade you hesitated on last Tuesday? The one where you stared at the chart, finger hovering over the buy button, then pulled back at the last second. It ended up ripping 12% in 3 hours. That feeling sucks.

We built something for those moments. Starting next week, Crypto AI will automatically log every chart you upload or analyze — even the ones you don't take. It creates a shadow journal of your near-trades, replaying the AI's verdict (entry, stop, target, confidence) so you can see exactly what you missed or avoided.

This isn't just a history log. It's a feedback loop. Every near-miss becomes a lesson. You'll start spotting patterns in your hesitation — and that's where the discipline gets forged. No more 'what if.' Just data.

Open the app now and upload a chart you've been watching. See what the AI says today. Then check back next week when the shadow journal goes live. P.S. — Early testers said this feature alone cut their FOMO buys by 40%. Yours is waiting.
